description:
I'm a passionate computer science student participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. I'm interested in software development, AI, web technologies, and space exploration. Currently, I'm working on an astronaut health monitoring system to support crew safety and well-being. I enjoy problem-solving, learning new technologies, and turning creative ideas into practical solutions.

I'm looking for motivated, creative, and collaborative teammates with skills in AI/ML, Python, web development, UI/.
